skills: Up to 5 Ether hits. The 5th is a Whim: an Ethereal figure strikes an area ahead; +40 Dream Points outside Dream.
A Whim: the figure slams an area for Ether DMG; +20 Dream Points outside Dream (once per 5s).
A Whim: the figure slams an area for Ether DMG; +20 Dream Points outside Dream (once per 5s).
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
A Harmony: the figure slams an area for Ether DMG; +40 Dream Points outside Dream.
A Whim: the figure slashes in a line for Ether DMG; +20 Dream Points outside Dream (once per 5s).
A Harmony: a powerful line slash for Ether DMG; +60 Dream Points outside Dream. In Dream inside Wellspring, extends Wellspring by 16s. Flows into the 5th Basic hit.
Any Harmony gives the squad Darkbreaker for 20s: +12 Sheer Force, plus more from her Max HP (maxes out at 24,000 initial Max HP). Harmony hits also add DMG based on her Max HP.
A Harmony: the figure pulls enemies in for Ether DMG; +40 Dream Points outside Dream.

A Harmony: rides the figure in a steerable charge (up to 3s; 40% DMG reduction; can't drop below 1 HP), then a wide Ether strike that triggers a Quick Assist and leaves Starlight Convergence for 8s (heals the on-field Agent from her Max HP). Extends Wellspring by 32s in Dream. +100 Dream Points; used in Dream, she re-enters Dream once when it ends.

core.name: Lost Nocturne
core.text:
Enters battle with 60 Dream Points; a Whim or Harmony at 100 puts her in Dream, triggering a Quick Assist and opening Ether Veil: Wellspring (squad Max HP +5% for 40s; extendable to 300s).
In Dream, Whims spend 25 Dream Points to become Harmonies, and a squadmate's hit can spend 25 for a Harmony Aftershock (8s cooldown after either). Each one gives the squad Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme: +{0}% DMG for 12s. Dream ends when Dream Points run out or she leaves the Ether Veil.

mindscapes: Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme's extra DMG ignores 18% All-Attribute RES with +5% Decibel generation. Each skill upgrade gives 1 Echo (max 4); when the Rhyme ends, an Echo reapplies it.
Inside Wellspring her Harmonies deal +15% DMG, and Darkbreaker Agents get +15% Sheer DMG.
Whenever an Ether Veil opens or is extended, the squad gets 100 Decibels (once per 15s).
Inside any Ether Veil: +ATK equal to 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmonies always CRIT with +30% CRIT DMG.
